page.heading: {source} to {destination}
page.removedBody: Its removal finished. Activity lists what happened to each of its events.
page.missingBody: It may have been removed or replaced. Return to the rules list to continue.
page.loadFailedBody: Check that the local service is running, then try again.

reprojectionRequired.one: Preview required. The policy changed. Preview this rule, then start syncing; {count} existing projection will be rewritten on the next run.
reprojectionRequired.other: Preview required. The policy changed. Preview this rule, then start syncing; {count} existing projections will be rewritten on the next run.

facts.title: What this rule does
facts.busyOnly: Busy only: titles, descriptions, and locations stay private
facts.copyDetails: Title, description, and location are copied

startingPointValue.one: Includes events from the past {count} day onward
startingPointValue.other: Includes events from the past {count} days onward

runs.title: Latest runs
runs.syncExplanation: Applies changes made in {source} since the previous run. Runs every five minutes.

reconciliationExplanation.one: Compares the events this rule wrote to {destination} from the past {count} day onward with their sources and reports any that differ, without changing them. Runs when you choose Reconcile now.
reconciliationExplanation.other: Compares the events this rule wrote to {destination} from the past {count} days onward with their sources and reports any that differ, without changing them. Runs when you choose Reconcile now.

drift.one: Checked {projections}: {count} difference found; it was not changed
drift.other: Checked {projections}: {count} differences found; none were changed

driftBlocked.one: Checked {projections}: {count} difference found; it was not changed. {blocked}
driftBlocked.other: Checked {projections}: {count} differences found; none were changed. {blocked}

policy.title: What {destination} shows
policy.intro: A change stops the rule from writing until you preview it again.
policy.allDayHint: Turn this off to synchronize timed events only.
policy.widensTitle: Everyone who can see {destination} will see event details
policy.saved: Policy saved. Preview the rule to start syncing with the new policy.

state.enabled: Synchronization pauses now. Preview the rule, then enable it again.
state.paused: The rule stays paused. Preview it before enabling it again.
state.degraded: The rule stays stopped until recovery. Its recovery preview also validates the new policy.
state.draft: The rule returns to draft. Preview it before enabling it.

exposeExisting.one: {count} existing projection in {destination} will show event titles, descriptions, and locations after the next run, to anyone who can see {destination}.
exposeExisting.other: {count} existing projections in {destination} will show event titles, descriptions, and locations after the next run, to anyone who can see {destination}.

change.exposeNew: New projections in {destination} will show event titles, descriptions, and locations to anyone who can see it.

redactExisting.one: {count} existing projection in {destination} will be rewritten as “{title}”, removing titles, descriptions, and locations.
redactExisting.other: {count} existing projections in {destination} will be rewritten as “{title}”, removing titles, descriptions, and locations.

change.allDayRemoved: All-day projections in {destination} will be deleted on the next run.
change.allDayAdded: All-day source events will be added to {destination} on the next run.
change.nothingChanges: Nothing changes in Google Calendar until the rule is enabled again.

projections.deleteHint: Only events this rule manages are deleted.
projections.deleteUnavailable: Reauthorize the destination account in Settings to delete projections.
projections.keepHint: They stay in {destination} and are never updated or deleted again.

delete.one: {count} projection this rule wrote will be deleted from {destination}. Source events are not changed. Any event whose ownership cannot be verified is left in place. This cannot be undone.
delete.other: {count} projections this rule wrote will be deleted from {destination}. Source events are not changed. Any event whose ownership cannot be verified is left in place. This cannot be undone.

detach.one: {count} projection stay in {destination} as ordinary events that are no longer updated or deleted. This cannot be undone.
detach.other: {count} projections stay in {destination} as ordinary events that are no longer updated or deleted. This cannot be undone.

replacement.title: Calendars
replacement.intro: Changing a calendar removes this rule and creates a new draft with the same policy.
replacement.sameEndpoint: Choose a destination different from the source calendar.
replacement.confirmTitle: Remove this rule and create a new draft?
replacement.confirmBody: {consequence} The new draft keeps this rule's policy and needs a preview before it can be enabled.
replacement.replaced: Calendars replaced. This is the new draft rule; preview it before it starts syncing.

removal.title: Remove rule
removal.activeBody: The rule no longer synchronizes. Source events are never changed. Removal continues if you leave this page.

incompleteBody.one: Removal stopped with {count} projection left. Retry to finish; the rule does not synchronize meanwhile.
incompleteBody.other: Removal stopped with {count} projections left. Retry to finish; the rule does not synchronize meanwhile.

removal.body: Removing a rule is permanent. Source events are never changed.
removal.connectionLost: The connection closed before the removal finished. It may still be running, so wait a minute, then check this page before retrying.

keeping.one: Keeping {count} event in {destination} as ordinary events…
keeping.other: Keeping {count} events in {destination} as ordinary events…

detached.one: {count} event stays in {destination} as a Detached Event.
detached.other: {count} events stay in {destination} as Detached Events.

conflicts.one: {count} event was left in {destination} because its ownership could not be verified. Review it in Activity under Blocked.
conflicts.other: {count} events were left in {destination} because their ownership could not be verified. Review them in Activity under Blocked.

outcome.unknown: The rule was removed. Any events left in {destination} because their ownership could not be verified are listed in Activity under Blocked.

run.upToDate: Up to date. Nothing changed since the last run.

checked.one: Checked {count} event this rule wrote to {destination}.
checked.other: Checked {count} events this rule wrote to {destination}.

checkedAllMatch.one: Checked {count} event this rule wrote to {destination}: every one matches its source event.
checkedAllMatch.other: Checked {count} events this rule wrote to {destination}: every one matches its source event.

checkedSeries.one: Checked {count} event this rule wrote to {destination} (a recurring series counts once).
checkedSeries.other: Checked {count} events this rule wrote to {destination} (a recurring series counts once).

settleAgain.one: If Reconcile now finds it again, Calendar Ghost can't settle it on its own.
settleAgain.other: If Reconcile now finds them again, Calendar Ghost can't settle them on its own.

unexpected.one: {count} still in {destination} though its source event was cancelled or excluded
unexpected.other: {count} still in {destination} though their source events were cancelled or excluded

run.previewNone: Start syncing to show events in {destination}.

previewedExcluded.one: Previewed {when}: {count} event will appear in {destination}, {excluded} excluded.
previewedExcluded.other: Previewed {when}: {count} events will appear in {destination}, {excluded} excluded.

run.enabled: Enabled. The first sync to {destination} runs within five minutes, or choose Sync now.
run.paused: Paused. Existing events stay in {destination}. Preview the rule again to resume.

recovery.authentication: Google authorization expired {when}, so Calendar Ghost stopped this rule to be safe.
recovery.authorization: Google calendar access was denied {when}, so Calendar Ghost stopped this rule to be safe.
recovery.rateLimit: Google Calendar was limiting requests {when}, so Calendar Ghost stopped this rule to be safe.
recovery.temporary: Google Calendar was temporarily unavailable {when}, so Calendar Ghost stopped this rule to be safe.
recovery.permanent: Google Calendar rejected a request {when}, so Calendar Ghost stopped this rule to be safe.
recovery.unknown: A sync could not finish {when}, so Calendar Ghost stopped this rule to be safe.
recovery.noFailure: Calendar Ghost stopped this rule to be safe.
recovery.next: Nothing was lost. Preview it to check both calendars, then start syncing again.

preview.summary: Preview found {eligible} eligible and {excluded} excluded events.
preview.summaryIncluding: Preview found {eligible} eligible and {excluded} excluded events, including {details}.

work.preview: Reading {source} to show what {destination} would get. Nothing is written yet.
work.reconciliationSyncing: Syncing every event from {source} to {destination}, then checking each one this rule wrote.
work.reconciliation: Checking every event this rule wrote to {destination} against {source}.

removalProgress.one: Removing this rule: handled {done} of {count} projection in {destination}.
removalProgress.other: Removing this rule: handled {done} of {count} projections in {destination}.

work.keepsRunning: It keeps running if you leave this page.

commands.syncNowDescription: Apply changes made in {source} since the last run. Runs by itself every five minutes.
commands.reconcileNowDescription: Sync in full, putting back events edited or deleted in {destination}, then check the events this rule wrote there from its starting point onward and report any that still differ.
commands.pauseDescription: Stop writing to {destination}. Existing events stay; resuming needs a new preview.
